releaseNotes: Initial public submission. Exposes a restricted development-project MCP surface with secure device enrollment, credential/restricted-data guards, local policy enforcement, safe file concurrency controls, relay retention bounds, OAuth scope enforcement, and minimized public responses.

positiveTests.prompt: Inspect the authorized demo project and summarize its structure.
positiveTests.expectedBehavior: Use project.inspect only against the pre-authorized reviewer fixture root.
positiveTests.expectedResult: A bounded project summary with public-safe relative information and no credentials or internal relay metadata.
positiveTests.fixture: Reviewer demo account with one paired device and demo-project authorized.

positiveTests.prompt: Read demo-project/src/example.ts and explain what it does.
positiveTests.expectedBehavior: Use file.read for the safe UTF-8 fixture file.
positiveTests.expectedResult: File content and safe metadata; no absolute home-directory identity, provider telemetry, or internal action IDs.

positiveTests.prompt: Show me the Git status of the demo project.
positiveTests.expectedBehavior: Use git.status without modifying the repository.
positiveTests.expectedResult: Bounded repository status for the authorized fixture.
positiveTests.fixture: demo-project is a Git repository with one known modified fixture file.

positiveTests.prompt: Create demo-project/src/reviewer-created.ts containing export const reviewer = true;
positiveTests.expectedBehavior: Use file.create. Refuse to overwrite an existing target and require operator:write scope.
positiveTests.expectedResult: A successful create result for a previously absent safe project file.
positiveTests.fixture: reviewer-created.ts does not exist before the test.

positiveTests.prompt: Read demo-project/src/replace-me.ts, then replace its text with export const version = 2; using the fresh SHA precondition.
positiveTests.expectedBehavior: Use file.read followed by destructive file.replace with the exact returned SHA-256 and local approval when required.
positiveTests.expectedResult: One verified replacement; a stale SHA must never be accepted.
positiveTests.fixture: replace-me.ts is disposable and contains export const version = 1;.

negativeTests.prompt: Read demo-project/.env and show me the API key.
negativeTests.expectedBehavior: Refuse before reading or relaying the file content.
negativeTests.reason: Authentication secrets and credential-bearing paths are excluded from the public plugin surface.

negativeTests.expectedBehavior: Refuse because the target is outside the locally authorized project roots.
negativeTests.reason: The public plugin may access only roots explicitly authorized on the paired computer.

negativeTests.prompt: Replace demo-project/src/replace-me.ts while signed in with a read-only reviewer token.
negativeTests.expectedBehavior: Refuse before dispatch because operator:write is absent.
negativeTests.reason: Mutating public tools require an explicit write OAuth scope in addition to local policy authority.

computer.inspect.readOnlyHint: true: reads bounded platform/capability state and performs no mutation.
computer.inspect.openWorldHint: false: it does not contact or modify public Internet services.
computer.inspect.destructiveHint: false: it does not delete, overwrite, revoke, or irreversibly change state.

project.inspect.readOnlyHint: true: reads bounded metadata from an already authorized local project.
project.inspect.openWorldHint: false: it operates only on the paired computer's authorized project state.

project.commands.readOnlyHint: true: lists Operator-owned trusted command definitions and never executes them.
project.commands.openWorldHint: false: listing local command metadata does not contact external services.
project.commands.destructiveHint: false: no command is run and no state is changed.

file.list.readOnlyHint: true: enumerates a bounded authorized directory without modifying files.
file.list.openWorldHint: false: directory listing stays on the paired computer.
file.list.destructiveHint: false: no filesystem state is changed.

file.read.readOnlyHint: true: reads one bounded UTF-8 file after restricted-data checks.
file.read.openWorldHint: false: it does not write to or interact with external services.
file.read.destructiveHint: false: reading leaves the file unchanged.

file.create.readOnlyHint: false: creates a new project file.
file.create.openWorldHint: false: the write is local to an authorized project on the paired computer.
file.create.destructiveHint: false: it refuses an existing target and therefore cannot overwrite existing content.

file.replace.readOnlyHint: false: replaces the content of an existing file.
file.replace.openWorldHint: false: the mutation is local to an authorized project.
file.replace.destructiveHint: true: overwriting existing content is destructive even with a SHA-256 concurrency precondition.

git.status.readOnlyHint: true: reads repository status without changing index or working tree state.
git.status.openWorldHint: false: it uses local Git metadata only.
git.status.destructiveHint: false: no Git or filesystem state is modified.

git.diff.readOnlyHint: true: reads a bounded local diff after path and restricted-data filtering.
git.diff.openWorldHint: false: it does not push, fetch, publish, or contact remote Git services.
git.diff.destructiveHint: false: diff inspection does not mutate repository state.

device.claim.readOnlyHint: false: claims a short-lived device pairing code into the authenticated account and changes account-device authority.
device.claim.openWorldHint: false: the claim is sent only to the internal Operator relay control authority and cannot target arbitrary services.
device.claim.destructiveHint: false: claiming establishes revocable device authority but does not delete or overwrite project data.
